messages.content: How much does membership cost?
Open studio membership is £95 a month. It includes 12 kg of house clay a month, shelf space and unlimited firings of house clay.
Can I cancel my membership?
Yes. Give one month's notice by email. There is no cancellation fee.
Which glaze is the most popular?
Tidepool, the blue-green glaze. It breaks to brown on edges and texture, which people love.
What is your refund policy?
Courses can be refunded in full up to 14 days before the first session. After that we can move you to a later course but can't refund.
Can I buy clay from you?
Yes. A 12.5 kg bag of Saltmarsh Buff costs £18 for members and £24 for non-members.
How do I reclaim clay?
Put slops and trimmings in the reclaim bucket by the sink, never down the drain. We recycle it into practice clay.
Why can't I pour clay down the sink?
Clay sets in pipes and blocks the drains. All sinks have a clay trap but it fills fast, so scrape tools into the reclaim bucket first.
Is there wifi?
Yes, ask at the front desk for the guest network password.
What are the studio notes on loading a glaze kiln?

Glazed pieces must not touch each other or the shelf. Check every foot is wiped clean of glaze, 5 mm up from the base. Use cookies under Rust Speckle and Midnight because they can run. Run the "Glaze 6 hold" program with a 10-minute hold at top temperature.
What are the studio notes on when the kiln shows error E1?
E1 means the kiln is heating slower than the program expects, usually because an element is worn out. Note the firing number, don't restart the program, and message Tom, who keeps the spare elements.
What are the studio notes on handling a kiln loss?

If someone's piece breaks in the kiln, keep the pieces in a labelled bag, look for the cause (air bubble, thick base, glaze on the foot), and talk them through it in person. Offer a free taster slot if it was the studio's fault.
What are the studio notes on studio safety?

No sweeping: dry clay dust is a silica hazard. Clean with a wet mop and sponges. Always wear a mask when mixing dry glaze materials. The first aid kit is above the sink and the fire blanket is next to the kilns.
perfect Can my 6 year old come to the kids club?
Kids' club is for ages 8 to 15. For a 6 year old, book a family taster and come along with them.
thx How do I know when to trim?
When it's leather hard: it holds its shape upside down but your fingernail still leaves a mark. If the tool chatters, it's too dry.
